2608.16627.title: When Do Explanations Help In-Context Learning? A Comparative Study of Natural Language Explanation Types and Faithfulness
2608.16627.paper_summary: Natural language explanations (NLEs) are increasingly used as inputs, for example, as few-shot rationales that influence model behavior in in-context learning (ICL). However, it remains unclear how different types of NLEs compare in their effects on downstream model performance in explanation-augmented prompting. Therefore, we provide a comparative evaluation across six benchmarks and four instruction-tuned models, studying how NLE source (human-written when available, self-generated explanations, generated by an external LLM) and NLE selection (random vs faithfulness-based filtering) affect downstream utility of NLEs when used in ICL settings. Our extensive evaluation shows that, on classification-style benchmarks, adding NLEs to few-shot prompts often improves accuracy over few-shot prompting without explanations; among NLE sources, externally generated LLM-NLEs often provide strong downstream utility and remain competitive with human rationales where both are available, whereas self-NLEs are more sensitive to the selection strategy. On math reasoning, the effects are more model- and source-dependent. We further show that faithfulness-based selection of self-NLEs yields small average gains overall, but can improve or reduce performance depending on the metric, task, and model. Different faithfulness metrics can disagree substantially, affecting which self-NLE examples are selected and their downstream predictive utility. Robustness tests with randomly swapped and out-of-distribution rationales indicate partial robustness, suggesting that semantic alignment contributes to performance gains. Overall, our results provide insights for selecting and reporting explanations that influence model behavior in practical prompting pipelines.
2608.16627.paper_summary_zh: 自然語言解釋（NLEs）越來越多地被用作輸入，例如，作為影響模型行為的少量示範推理，應用於上下文學習（ICL）。然而，尚不清楚不同類型的NLE在解釋增強提示中對下游模型性能的影響如何比較。因此，我們提供了在六個基準和四個指令調整模型之間的比較評估，研究NLE來源（在可用時為人類撰寫、自我生成的解釋、由外部LLM生成）和NLE選擇（隨機與基於忠實度的過濾）如何影響在ICL設置中使用NLE的下游效用。我們的廣泛評估顯示，在分類風格的基準上，將NLE添加到少量提示中通常會提高準確性，相較於不使用解釋的少量提示；在NLE來源中，外部生成的LLM-NLE通常提供強大的下游效用，並在兩者均可用的情況下與人類推理保持競爭力，而自我NLE則對選擇策略更為敏感。在數學推理中，效果則更依賴於模型和來源。我們進一步顯示，基於忠實度的自我NLE選擇整體上產生小幅的平均增益，但根據指標、任務和模型的不同，可能會提高或降低性能。不同的忠實度指標可能會有顯著的分歧，影響所選擇的自我NLE示例及其下游預測效用。隨機交換和超出分佈的推理的穩健性測試顯示出部分穩健性，表明語義對齊有助於性能提升。總體而言，我們的結果為選擇和報告影響模型行為的解釋提供了見解，以應用於實際的提示管道中。
